news.headline: Abivax (ABVX): TCG Crossover and Chen Yu report 7.0% ADS stake
Abivax S.A. (ABVX) investors report 6.0% beneficial stake via Invus entities
Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback aligning with Abivax's planned NDA submission strategy and content for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis. Abivax confirmed it remains on track to submit its first NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180 from $132, Maintains Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley raised its price target on Abivax to $180 from $132 while reiterating an Overweight rating, citing confidence following the strengthened Phase 3 ulcerative colitis safety data and progress toward FDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders (heads of marketing, patient services, sales/commercial operations, and market access) to build out its organization ahead of a planned Q4 2026 U.S. NDA submission and potential launch of obefazimod.

news.headline: Abivax Re-engages Centerview Amid Renewed Takeover Interest
news.summary: French financial newsletter La Lettre reported Abivax re-engaged advisory firm Centerview Partners amid renewed takeover speculation, following earlier rumors that Eli Lilly could be prepared to pay around 15 billion euro for the company. Abivax has not confirmed any formal M&A process.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed its upsized public offering after underwriters fully exercised their option, bringing gross proceeds to $920 million (about 807 million euro). Combined with existing cash, the company said this extends its runway into Q4 2029, reducing near-term reliance on a partner or acquirer for its planned U.S. launch.

news.headline: Abivax Reports Positive ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Results for Obefazimod, Strengthening the Phase 3 Maintenance Safety Database
news.summary: Expanded Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance data showed no new safety signal and cancer rates within the expected range for ulcerative colitis patients, easing concerns raised by an earlier readout; 37.2% of prior induction non-responders reached clinical remission at week 44. Shares jumped roughly 36% on the news, reversing much of a prior sell-off tied to earlier cancer-case worries.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA
catalysts.detail: Following a positive pre-NDA meeting, Abivax plans to submit its first New Drug Application for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis to the FDA in Q4 2026.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's next scheduled financial update, expected to include regulatory and pipeline progress commentary.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results / trading update
catalysts.detail: Next scheduled quarterly financial and corporate update, likely coinciding with the planned NDA filing window.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA decision on obefazimod NDA
catalysts.detail: If the NDA is filed as planned in Q4 2026, a standard FDA review cycle would put a decision (PDUFA-type date) roughly in mid-to-late 2027; exact timing depends on filing acceptance and review designation, not yet confirmed by the company.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease induction data
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction results from the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial of obefazimod in Crohn's disease are anticipated, expanding the drug's potential indications beyond ulcerative colitis.

catalysts.label: M&A / takeover speculation
catalysts.detail: Reports of Abivax re-engaging advisor Centerview Partners and prior rumors of Eli Lilly interest (reportedly around 15 billion euro) keep speculative takeover interest alive, though no formal process has been confirmed by the company.

pulse: Abivax has rebuilt significant momentum since early July, powered by expanded Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance data that eased earlier cancer-signal concerns, a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA keeping the Q4 2026 filing on track, and a $920 million capital raise that funds operations into Q4 2029 and reduces urgency for a partner. Analyst sentiment has turned more bullish (Morgan Stanley to $180 Overweight) and the company is actively building out its U.S. commercial organization, while persistent takeover chatter (Centerview re-engagement, prior Eli Lilly rumors) adds an M&A option value on top of the standalone launch case. Key near-term watch items are the actual NDA submission, the September/December financial updates, and any signal on a formal EMA filing or acquisition process.
